faq.billQ: Why doesn't the price match my bill?
faq.billA: The spot price is only part of your bill. Add your grid fee and your electricity company's markup under Settings → Your real price, and Elpuls adds energy tax and VAT too. Fixed monthly fees aren't part of the price per kWh.
faq.zonesA: Sweden is split into four price zones with different prices. Power is usually cheapest in the north and most expensive in the south. Your zone is on your electricity bill, e.g. "Elområde: 3".
faq.coloursQ: What do the chart colours mean?
faq.coloursA: Each time is compared with that day's average: Cheap, Normal, Expensive and Most expensive. So an expensive day can still have cheap hours, and the other way round.
faq.quarterQ: Why are there prices per 15 minutes?
faq.quarterA: Since October 2025 the electricity price is set per 15 minutes instead of per hour. You choose whether the chart shows hours or 15-minute periods.
faq.proQ: What do I get with Pro?
faq.proA: Notifications when it pays to run the laundry, dishes or charging, a daily explanation of prices, a heating plan, solar hours, best times in the chart, and Stats. Free for {{days}} days, then 39 kr a month.
faq.controlA: No. Elpuls only gives tips. You start the laundry, the charging or the heating yourself, when it suits you.
faq.sourceQ: Where do the prices come from?
faq.sourceA: Spot prices come from Nord Pool via elprisetjustnu.se, and the weather from SMHI. Tomorrow's prices usually arrive shortly after 13:00.
faq.privacyA: No. The photo or PDF is read once to find the fees and isn't kept. Only the numbers you confirm are saved.
